keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Bruno Damiani (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alejandro Alvarado (San Diego) is shown the yellow card.

Goal! San Diego 0, Philadelphia Union 1. Cavan Sullivan (Philadelphia Union) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Indiana Vassilev following a fast break.
Neil Pierre (Philadelphia Union) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins San Diego 0, Philadelphia Union 1.
Substitution, San Diego. David Vazquez replaces Onni Valakari.
Substitution, San Diego. Aníbal Godoy replaces Alejandro Alvarado.
